# Progression options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

7 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `Progression`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GroupXpDistance` | `float` | `74` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | MaxGroupXPDistance (yards): the reward distance for XP, quest kill credit and kill reputation, measured by GroupRewardRange (2D, strict less-than, widened by both bounding radii, +150 yards for world bosses, unlimited on raid maps, a dead member counts through his corpse). |
| `LevelStatsPath` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | Optional developer-supplied level stats file (see `PlayerLevelStatsTable`). Absent: level-ups change level and XP but no base health, mana or stats. |
| `MaxPlayerLevel` | `uint` | `60` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | MaxPlayerLevel: no experience is gained at or above it. |
| `RateXpKill` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Rate.XP.Kill. |
| `RateXpKillElite` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Rate.XP.Kill.Elite. |
| `RateXpPersonalMax` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.XP.Personal.Max (World.cpp:511, setConfigMin 0, default 1): the highest personal XP rate a player below GameMaster may set with `.modify xprate` (CharacterCommands.cpp:84-88). A negative value is replaced by 1 when the command reads it. |
| `RateXpPersonalMin` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.XP.Personal.Min (World.cpp:510, setConfigMin 0, default 1): the lowest personal XP rate `.modify xprate` accepts (CharacterCommands.cpp:78-82). A negative value is replaced by 1 when the command reads it. |
